arguments.proof:
intro τ α β hτ
let h : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => KdVPlan.phase α t - KdVPlan.avg τ (KdVPlan.phase α)
have hu : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt h ((-Complex.I * (α : ℂ)) * KdVPlan.phase α x) x := fun x => (yui_aux_0002 T gamma R α x).sub_const _
have hi := intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul (a := 0) (b := τ)
  (u := h) (v := KdVPlan.phase β)
  (u' := fun x => (-Complex.I * (α : ℂ)) * KdVPlan.phase α x)
  (v' := fun x => (-Complex.I * (β : ℂ)) * KdVPlan.phase β x)
  (fun x _ => hu x) (fun x _ => yui_aux_0002 T gamma R β x)
  ((continuous_const.mul (yui_aux_0004 T gamma R α)).intervalIntegrable _ _)
  ((continuous_const.mul (yui_aux_0004 T gamma R β)).intervalIntegrable _ _)
have heq : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..τ, h x * ((-Complex.I * (β : ℂ)) * KdVPlan.phase β x)) =
    (-Complex.I * (β : ℂ)) * (τ : ℂ) * KdVPlan.eta τ α β := by
  rw [yui_aux_0009 T gamma R]
  have hc : (τ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hτ
  calc
    _ = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..τ, (-Complex.I * (β : ℂ)) * (h x * KdVPlan.phase β x) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x hx
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]; dsimp [h]; field_simp
rw [heq] at hi
exact hi

arguments.statement: ∀ τ α β : ℝ, 0 < τ → β ≠ 0 → ‖KdVPlan.eta τ α β‖ ≤ 2 * |α/β|
arguments.proof:
intro τ α β hτ hβ
let A : ℂ := (KdVPlan.phase α τ - KdVPlan.avg τ (KdVPlan.phase α)) * KdVPlan.phase β τ
let B : ℂ := (KdVPlan.phase α 0 - KdVPlan.avg τ (KdVPlan.phase α)) * KdVPlan.phase β 0
let I : ℂ := ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..τ, ((-Complex.I * (α : ℂ)) * KdVPlan.phase α t) * KdVPlan.phase β t
have hi : ‖I‖ ≤ |α| * τ := by
  have hi := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := τ)
    (f := fun t => ((-Complex.I * (α : ℂ)) * KdVPlan.phase α t) * KdVPlan.phase β t)
    (C := |α|) (fun t _ => by simp [norm_mul, yui_aux_0001 T gamma R, Complex.norm_real])
  simpa [I, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hτ] using hi
have heq : (-Complex.I * (β : ℂ)) * (τ : ℂ) * KdVPlan.eta τ α β = A - B - I :=
  yui_aux_0011 T gamma R τ α β (ne_of_gt hτ)
have hb : ‖(-Complex.I * (β : ℂ)) * (τ : ℂ) * KdVPlan.eta τ α β‖ ≤ ‖A‖ + ‖B‖ + ‖I‖ := by
  rw [heq]
  exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add_right (norm_sub_le _ _) _)
simp only [norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_I, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, one_mul, abs_of_pos hτ] at hb
have he : ‖A‖ + ‖B‖ ≤ τ * |α| := by
  simpa [A, B, norm_mul, yui_aux_0001 T gamma R, add_comm] using (yui_aux_0008 T gamma R τ α hτ).2
have hm : |β| * ‖KdVPlan.eta τ α β‖ ≤ 2 * |α| := by
  apply (mul_le_mul_left hτ).mp
  nlinarith
rw [abs_div, ← mul_div_assoc]
apply (le_div_iff₀ (abs_pos.mpr hβ)).mpr
nlinarith [hm]

result.statement: ∀ τ α β : ℝ, 0 < τ → β ≠ 0 → ‖KdVPlan.eta τ α β‖ ≤ 2 * |α/β|
result.proof:
intro τ α β hτ hβ
let A : ℂ := (KdVPlan.phase α τ - KdVPlan.avg τ (KdVPlan.phase α)) * KdVPlan.phase β τ
let B : ℂ := (KdVPlan.phase α 0 - KdVPlan.avg τ (KdVPlan.phase α)) * KdVPlan.phase β 0
let I : ℂ := ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..τ, ((-Complex.I * (α : ℂ)) * KdVPlan.phase α t) * KdVPlan.phase β t
have hi : ‖I‖ ≤ |α| * τ := by
  have hi := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := τ)
    (f := fun t => ((-Complex.I * (α : ℂ)) * KdVPlan.phase α t) * KdVPlan.phase β t)
    (C := |α|) (fun t _ => by simp [norm_mul, yui_aux_0001 T gamma R, Complex.norm_real])
  simpa [I, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hτ] using hi
have heq : (-Complex.I * (β : ℂ)) * (τ : ℂ) * KdVPlan.eta τ α β = A - B - I :=
  yui_aux_0011 T gamma R τ α β (ne_of_gt hτ)
have hb : ‖(-Complex.I * (β : ℂ)) * (τ : ℂ) * KdVPlan.eta τ α β‖ ≤ ‖A‖ + ‖B‖ + ‖I‖ := by
  rw [heq]
  exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add_right (norm_sub_le _ _) _)
simp only [norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_I, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, one_mul, abs_of_pos hτ] at hb
have he : ‖A‖ + ‖B‖ ≤ τ * |α| := by
  simpa [A, B, norm_mul, yui_aux_0001 T gamma R, add_comm] using (yui_aux_0008 T gamma R τ α hτ).2
have hm : |β| * ‖KdVPlan.eta τ α β‖ ≤ 2 * |α| := by
  apply yui_aux_0012 T gamma R τ _ _ hτ
  nlinarith
rw [abs_div, ← mul_div_assoc]
apply (le_div_iff₀ (abs_pos.mpr hβ)).mpr
nlinarith [hm]

arguments.statement: ∀ τ β : ℝ, 0 < τ → KdVPlan.eta τ 0 β = 0
arguments.proof:
intro τ β hτ
have hc : (τ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hτ)
have havg : KdVPlan.avg τ (KdVPlan.phase 0) = 1 := by
  simp [KdVPlan.avg, KdVPlan.phase, Complex.real_smul, hc]
simp [KdVPlan.eta, havg]

arguments.proof:
unfold KdVPlan.CovarianceBounds
intro τ α β hτ
constructor
· intro hz
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz with hα | hβ
  · subst α
    exact yui_aux_0016 T gamma R τ β hτ
  · subst β
    rw [yui_aux_0015 T gamma R]
    exact yui_aux_0016 T gamma R τ α hτ
· intro hn
  have hα : α ≠ 0 := fun h => hn (by simp [h])
  have hβ : β ≠ 0 := fun h => hn (by simp [h])
  have hrα := yui_aux_0014 T gamma R τ α β hτ hβ
  have hrβ : ‖KdVPlan.eta τ α β‖ ≤ 2 * |β / α| := by
    rw [yui_aux_0015 T gamma R]
    exact yui_aux_0014 T gamma R τ β α hτ hα
  have hsα := yui_aux_0010 T gamma R τ α β hτ
  have hsβ : ‖KdVPlan.eta τ α β‖ ≤ τ * |β| := by
    rw [yui_aux_0015 T gamma R]
    exact yui_aux_0010 T gamma R τ β α hτ
  constructor
  · rcases le_total |α / β| |β / α| with h | h
    · rw [min_eq_left h]
      exact hrα
    · rw [min_eq_right h]
      exact hrβ
  · rcases le_total |α| |β| with h | h
    · rw [min_eq_left h]
      exact hsα
    · rw [min_eq_right h]
      exact hsβ
